issue_context.title: [Bug]: It ignores a bad `tsconfig` setting
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.50.1

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a file named `tsconfig.test.json`
2. Set this in your options: 
  ```js
  export default defineConfig({
    tsconfig: "./tsconfig.e2e.json",
  });
  ```
3. Run playwright 

### Expected behavior

```
Uncaught [Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open './tsconfig.e2e.json']
```

Note that the file you created was `*.test.json`, not `*.e2e.json`. You made a mistake in the config and Playwright should call you out on it.

### Actual behavior

Unrelated errors caused by playwright reading `tsconfig.json` or whatever.

### Additional context

_No response_

### Environment

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 15.3.1
    Memory: 98.55 MB / 16.00 GB
  Binaries:
    Node: 20.12.0 - /usr/local/bin/node
    npm: 10.5.0 - /usr/local/bin/npm
  Languages:
    Bash: 3.2.57 - /bin/bash
```

review_comments:
The error message should use `overrides.tsconfig` instead of `options.tsconfig` for consistency.
```suggestion
    throw new Error(`--tsconfig "${overrides.tsconfig}" does not exist`);
```
nope, that was on purpose! the user should see what they specified
